title: Mostly.Vanilla
description: A MOSTLY Vanilla modpack that makes Minecraft Vanilla better
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1fac95c9b188f3d92d8438ce328da32ff889bec.png)
 **Better biomes, more life, no lag.**

MOSTLY Vanilla is a 1.21.1 Fabric overhaul designed to make Minecraft feel like a modern sequel. It focuses on massive world exploration and deep visual polish while staying optimized enough to run on low-end hardware.

### 🌎 A Reimagined World
The overworld is transformed by realistic mountain ranges and grand landscapes. With overhauled Caves, Bridges, and End Islands, every landmark is worth exploring. Even the Nether and the End have been rebuilt to feel like entirely new dimensions.

### 🦊 Mobs That Feel Alive
Every creature now has fluid, expressive movement. We’ve also brought back "lost vote" mobs to fill out the world's ecosystems, making every forest and ocean feel diverse and complete.

### 🛠️ Immersive Details
It’s the small things that make a pack "perfected":
* **Visuals:** 3D rails, glowing ores, fancy crops, and better-looking lanterns.
* **UI:** A clean, dark-themed interface with integrated HUDs for your inventory and armor status.
* **Audio:** Realistic footsteps and ambient environment sounds for deep atmosphere.

### ⚙️ High-End Performance for Low-End PCs
Don't let the visuals fool you. MOSTLY Vanilla is built on an elite optimization stack. It’s specifically tuned to deliver high frame rates and fast loading times, even on older CPUs or systems with limited RAM.

### ⚔️ Enhanced Gameplay
Combat and exploration feel smoother with a better third-person camera, 3D armor trims, and visual enchantment outlines. Whether you are building a kingdom or hunting for the "True Ending," the game stays out of your way and lets you play.

---

### 🎮 Requirements & Recommendations
* **Version:** 1.21.1 (Fabric)
* **RAM:** 4GB Recommended.
* **Shaders:** Pre-loaded with high-performance options including **Complementary Reimagined**, **Bliss**, **Nostalgia**, and **Super Duper Vanilla**. **Rethinking Voxels** is included for high-end lighting.
---
### 📜 **<u>The Echo of the Forgotten</u>**

The world of **MOSTLY Vanilla** is a *reclamation*. Long ago, a massive medieval civilization peaked, leaving behind the **<u>Towns, Towers, and Bridges</u>** that now sit weathered by time. They sought the *True Ending*, but instead, the world fractured. 

The land grew restless as *Terralith* and *Tectonic* forces warped the horizon, creating jagged peaks and deep, bioluminescent scars. Nature didn't just return; it **evolved**. The creatures you see—the **"Lost Mobs"**—are the survivors of this shift, moving with a *fluid, uncanny grace* as they watch from the shadows of **<u>Medieval Buildings</u>**. From the gothic decay of the **Nether** to the shattered memories of the **End**, the world is **<u>mostly</u>** familiar, but it hides an ancient hunger for a new legend to finish what the ancients started.

---

### 🖥️ **<u>Tested On: Performance & Compatibility</u>**

This modpack is built to be **<u>mostly</u>** playable on any hardware. It has been rigorously tested to ensure a "no lag" experience even on entry-level systems.

**<u>Current Test Bench Specs:</u>**
* **CPU:** Intel Pentium Silver J5005
* **RAM:** 8GB (Pack tested with 5GB allocated)
* **Graphics:** Integrated UHD 605
* **OS:** Windows

**<u>The Results:</u>**
* **Framerate:** Solid FPS with optimization mods (**Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore**).
* **Shaders:** High-performance playability with **<u>Super Duper Vanilla</u>** and **<u>Mellow Shaders</u>**.
* **Stability:** 0 crashes during extended world-gen testing with **Terralith** and **Tectonic**.

> *“If it runs this smooth on a Pentium, it’ll fly on your rig.”*
